scope: Actual native 1s moving-driver pilot; sampled unilateral loading/release, not calibrated landslide validation
morphologyReview: Unamplified overview inspected: small distributed creep, no detached mass or run-out
limits: Contact force/gaps are the last predicted BC evaluation; settlement is current MP geometry
0.1s samples do not establish zero force at every intervening step or an integrated actuator-work budget
Original tracked surface/profile, finite penalty, no new surface search/tangential traction
The inherited penalty timestep and actual early contact force differ from the gravity-only pilot; do not call them an exact physics match
Slow driver releases once soil moves ahead; this pilot does not justify a long run as a sustained loading experiment
